verses.text: Of David. Praise the LORD, my soul! Everything in me, praise his holy name!
Praise the LORD, my soul, and do not forget all the good things he does.
He forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.
He rescues your life from the grave and crowns you with faithful love and mercy.
He satisfies you with good things, so that you feel young and strong again, like an eagle.
The LORD does what is right and gives justice to all who are treated cruelly.
He showed his ways to Moses and his mighty acts to the people of Israel.
The LORD is full of mercy and kindness. He is slow to get angry and full of faithful love.
He will not always accuse us. He will not stay angry forever.
He does not punish us as our sins deserve, or pay us back for the wrong things we have done.
As high as the skies are above the earth, that is how great his faithful love is for those who respect him.
As far as the east is from the west, that is how far he has taken our sins away from us.
As a father has mercy on his children, the LORD has mercy on those who respect him.
He knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
Human life is like grass. People grow like flowers in a field.
When the wind blows over them, they are gone, and no one remembers where they were.
But the LORD's faithful love lasts forever and ever for those who respect him. His goodness continues to their grandchildren,
to those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his commands.
The LORD has set up his throne in heaven. His kingdom rules over everything.
Praise the LORD, you mighty angels who do what he says and obey his word.
Praise the LORD, all his armies of heaven, you servants who do what he wants.
Praise the LORD, everything he has made, everywhere in his kingdom. Praise the LORD, my soul!
